title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Beacon Theatre, New York City | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Beacon Theatre in New York City, USA, on 8 June 2022.

It was the ninth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022, and the last of three consecutive nights in NYC.

Starr had previously performed at the Beacon Theatre on 16 and 17 February 1999, 23 May 2000, 17 and 18 June 2014, and 15 November 2017.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet

Edgar Winter did not perform at this show due to Covid-19.
